title: Volumetric Fire & Smoke — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Spark to connected system
scenes.purpose: Show an idea igniting as a raymarched volumetric flame whose cooling smoke branches link three ember nodes, staged with the blast_aftermath recipe (compression, shock, debris, cooling).
visuals: Stationary #101218 stage with an analytic coal (#4B403A) hearth disk receiving flicker light spill
WebGL2 fragment-shader raymarched flame volume with approximate temperature ramp #FFF0BC -> #FFAD42 -> #F05A28
Translucent #747B86 smoke volume branching from the flame tip to three emissive ember nodes, then linked by thin arcs
Ground shock ring and displaced dust torus at deterministic radius, plus ten ballistic debris embers that land on the hearth
Serif copy bottom-left, tag bottom-right, disclosure caption top-left

beats.development: Compression: a small bright core contracts on the coal bed and lights the hearth centre.
Ignition and expanding force: shock ring and dust torus travel outward across the floor, debris embers arc out and land, flame volume rises; disclosure caption fades in.
captions: Illustrative procedural volume — not a combustion solver

beats.development: Tall readable flame; smoke trunk forks and grows to the top, left and right ember nodes, which light on arrival; arcs begin linking nodes. Headline, subhead and tag appear.
Cooling aftermath: flame shortens and cools into translucent smoke, light spill dims, linking arcs complete; advection eases to a settled state by 2.7s and holds.

findings: Blast staging spans compression, shock propagation, debris flight and cooling across 0-2.7s rather than a single flash.
All copy is fully visible by 1.8s and the composition is settled by 2.7s.
justifiedHolds: 2.7-3.0s final hold lets the connected-system frame and copy be read.

notes: GSAP paused timeline owns every uniform (uTime, uIgnite, uCool, uCompress, uShock, uShockFade, uDebris, uLinkA/B/C, uArc); each update and hf-seek redraws one frame.
Covers optional recipe blast_aftermath within the primary volumetric fire style.
Blender/Cycles gas simulation is the validated route for physically simulated shots and is unavailable here.
